The '''Whisper''' was a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It came equipped with [[Sound baffler]]s and was noted for its rugged design and top-rate performance. It was capable of hover mode and had a maximum altitude range of 70 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The Whisper was the preferred jetpack for [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]] of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].<ref name="RoE" />
